versions.changelog: La skill puente ahora se llama f100k-puente

Initial release of the guionizacion-ads-formula100k skill for OpenClaw.

- Automates paid ad scriptwriting (Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, YouTube Ads, Reels promocionados) using the FÓRMULA 100K method: Hook × Meat × CTA.
- Modular script output: 10 GOAT-style hooks, 4-part meat, 3 CTA levels, and three calibrated scripts per platform/duration.
